title: Four men shot dead in an ambush on their car in Tulunan, Datu Anggal Midtimbang
summary: Four men travelling together in a silver car were killed in an ambush on the afternoon of Monday, 26 October 2026, along a highway in an interior part of Barangay Tulunan, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, Maguindanao del Sur. All four died instantly from multiple gunshot wounds. Col. Michael John Mangahis, the Maguindanao del Sur police provincial director, and local officials said the victims were most likely not residents of the province; as of 4 pm they had not been identified. The Army’s 6th Infantry Division is helping police identify the victims and the attackers.

sources.title: 4 men killed in Maguindanao del Sur ambush
